method: Matched on/off pairs from independent histories at the same simulation frame. PNG sheets use native-resolution source crops, TAA off left and on right. Pan/orbit lossless WebP uses 67 ms per frame, approximately four times slower than capture; no new renders were made. Meteor detail images use 4x nearest-neighbor enlargement of the exact crop; no filtering or synthesis is applied.

observations: TAA smooths the visible pixel stepping along the roof ridge, diagonal eaves and thin window bars in both paths. Roof texture and timber detail are visibly softer.
The reviewed sequence shows no observed oscillating doubled house edge, halo or temporal trail. This is a short visual assessment rather than a numerical edge-crawl metric.

Detached roof, wall, beam and window silhouettes change position across consecutive frames; no clearly separated multi-frame duplicate debris silhouette is visible in the reviewed High or Medium sheets.

The left meteor head moves rapidly through frames 469–472. Magnified TAA-on frames 470–472 show a head-shaped outline inside the emissive ribbon that is absent from TAA-off. A precise one-frame versus multi-frame persistence attribution is not established without matching its reprojected earlier position. The physical ribbon itself is present in both variants.
limits: Fire, smoke, overlapping geometry and bloom hide faint or subpixel ghosts. These sixteen frames do not measure ghost length or cover all velocities, materials, disocclusions, camera cuts or gameplay views.

Saved capture metadata names the scripted camera path; exact resulting view matrices, including any camera shake, are not retained. Both renderers consume the identical current view/state in the paired method.
moving_debris.meteor_duration_acceptance: unestablished; observed TAA-only head outline requires caution

source_review.inference: Falling meteor rocks are drawn into a per-frame Mesh, while the TAA MotionDraw list is built from InstancedFigure buffers. This appears to leave meteor heads with camera-only reprojection, unlike instanced structural chunks; it is a plausible cause of the TAA-only outline.
